items.name: Red Potion
items.notes: Best raw HP per meso among the standard small HP choices.

items.name: Orange Potion
items.notes: A larger refill that cuts down on presses as the HP pool grows.

items.name: White Potion
items.notes: The practical high-level HP refill; fewer uses matter more than perfect raw efficiency.

items.name: Meat
items.notes: Matches Red Potion on raw HP per meso; availability depends on the town shop.

items.name: Fried Chicken
items.notes: Matches Red Potion on raw HP per meso with a slightly larger single-use refill.

items.name: Hamburger
items.notes: Food alternative to White Potion when the shop carries it.

items.name: Orange
items.notes: Best raw MP per meso; keep it for small pools or maximum savings.

items.name: Lemon
items.notes: Best raw MP per meso with fewer presses than Orange.

items.name: Blue Potion
items.notes: The standard midgame MP refill; a sensible click-saving tradeoff.

items.name: Pure Water
items.notes: Large refill for high-MP grinding sessions; not the raw-efficiency winner.

hp.reason: Small early HP pools make Red Potion the cheapest practical refill.
Orange Potion cuts the number of uses once Warrior HP starts to widen.
White Potion keeps high-level Fighter top-offs manageable without spamming tiny pots.

mp.reason: Fighter MP stays small early, so Orange wins on raw MP per meso.
Blue Potion saves enough presses after Fighter advancement to justify its small efficiency loss.
Pure Water avoids a backpack full of tiny MP refills during late grinding.

mp.reason: Hunter MP stays small early, so Orange wins on raw MP per meso.

hp.reason: Mages have a small HP pool early; Red Potion keeps emergency healing cheap.
Orange Potion is a practical middle tier once travel and monster damage increase.
White Potion makes high-level emergency top-offs manageable while Magic Guard is active.

mp.reason: Lemon keeps the best raw MP per meso while avoiding Orange-sized click spam.
Blue Potion is the balanced midgame choice as spell costs and MP pools rise.
Pure Water keeps high-MP grinding sessions from turning into constant refill presses.
